use arena::{
    Arena, ArenaMap, DroplessArena, Idx, LayeredArena, LayeredArenaMap, SharedSlicePool, SlicePool,
    StaticSliceArena,
};
fn main() {
    let mut a = Arena::new();
    let x = a.alloc(11i32);
    let y = a.alloc(22);
    a[x] += 3;
    assert_eq!(a[x] + a[y], 36);
    assert_eq!(a.next_idx().into_raw(), 2);
    let mut map = ArenaMap::<i32, i32>::new();
    map.insert(Idx::from_raw(100), 7);
    map.insert(x, 9);
    map.insert(y, 5);
    *map.get_mut(x).unwrap() += 1;
    assert_eq!(map.remove(y), Some(5));
    assert_eq!(map.iter().count(), 2);
    println!("arena {} {} map {}", a[x], a[y], map[x]);
    let mut layers = LayeredArena::new();
    layers.freeze();
    let first = layers.alloc(String::from("base"));
    layers.freeze();
    let mut copy = layers.clone();
    let last = copy.alloc(String::from("tail"));
    copy.freeze();
    copy.freeze();
    assert_eq!(layers.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(copy.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(copy[first], "base");
    assert_eq!(copy.values().rev().count(), 2);
    let mut m = LayeredArenaMap::<String, String>::new();
    m.insert(first, String::from("base"));
    m.freeze();
    let mut n = m.clone();
    n.get_mut(first).unwrap().push('!');
    n.insert(last, String::from("tail"));
    n.freeze();
    n.freeze();
    assert_eq!(m[first], "base");
    assert_eq!(n.iter().count(), 2);
    assert!(n.get(Idx::from_raw(20)).is_none());
    println!("layered {} {}", copy[last], n[first]);
    let mut pool = SlicePool::default();
    let id = pool.alloc([2, 4, 6]);
    assert_eq!(&pool[id], &[2, 4, 6]);
    let mut shared = SharedSlicePool::default();
    let owned = shared.alloc([3, 5, 7]);
    let preserved = owned.clone();
    drop(shared);
    drop(owned);
    assert_eq!(&*preserved, &[3, 5, 7]);
    let mut statics = StaticSliceArena::new();
    let permanent = statics.alloc(&[1, 3, 5]);
    drop(statics);
    assert_eq!(permanent, &[1, 3, 5]);
    let bump = DroplessArena::new();
    let value = bump.alloc(9u64);
    let text = bump.alloc_str("arena");
    assert_eq!(text, "arena");
    assert_eq!(bump.alloc_slice(&[8u32, 9]), &[8, 9]);
    println!(
        "shared {} static {} bump {}",
        preserved.len(),
        permanent.len(),
        value
    );
}
